readerCopy.body: A promising future can make you see which old success story still defines what counts as progress. When Jupiter opposes the South Node, a new opportunity, belief, trip, course, or expansion can stand directly across from a path that once made sense. You may be tempted to measure the new option using an older definition of success. Keep the experience that taught you something. Let the definition change if your life has changed.
